---
title: "Reveal.js config values that hold a closing script tag"
format:
  revealjs:
    auto-animate-easing: "ease</script>"
language:
  revealjs-menu-button-label: "Menu</script> $&"
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '"openButtonLabel":"Menu\\u003c/script> \$&"'
          - '''autoAnimateEasing'': "ease\\u003c/script>"'
        -
          - 'Menu</script>'
          - 'ease</script>'
---

Quarto writes the Reveal.js configuration, including the slide menu button
label from the language files and metadata such as `auto-animate-easing`, as
JSON inside the `Reveal.initialize` script. A value holding `</script>` must be
escaped, or it closes that script early and the presentation never starts.
A value holding `$&` must be written as is, not read as a replacement pattern
when the configuration is inserted into the script.
